answer: Keep a living atlas of earning rights: every identity must sustain a continuous chain of sequential proofs, climbing a mesa one verifiable step at a time, each step taking real wall-clock time that cannot be parallelized. An identity may only earn in proportion to its chain's progress, so a Sybil farmer must pay full, ongoing compute for every account in its sable fleet — splitting one machine across a hundred identities earns no more than running a single honest agent.
